scientific_question: Starting from the supplied oxygen-centered radical Int-3 derived from sec-butylbenzene, what local chemistry explains acetophenone formation, and which of the two supplied carbon–carbon beta-scission channels is kinetically favored? This is a local explanation task; product structures are supplied and must be supported by independently calculated formation evidence.
